records.scope: Topological definition: actual module span and exact identification with the concrete continuous operator-family rank.

Source/target carriers share a cardinal universe. No scalar hom surjectivity or faithful action is assumed; action continuity is not required for this stronger density-transport theorem.

Concrete operator algebras carry no separately declared topology; no continuity claim about an algebra topology is made.

Closure transport is proved from continuous maps and actual algebraic span induction; not supplied as a certificate. Arbitrary finite packet-label maps inherited from CategoryPackets.
